remarks: Location, Location, Location! Welcome to Woodside Green, an inviting park-like pet-friendly community located in the heart of midtown Stamford!   This spacious third-floor unit offers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and modern updates.  Upon entry, you'll find a hallway with a coat closet for additional storage. To the right, a full bath with a window provides natural light and features a single vanity. The kitchen has been freshly painted and includes a new microwave: a perfect space for cooking and meal prep. The large living room offers plenty of room for both a seating area and a dining space, making it ideal for entertaining or relaxing. The unit features a generous primary bedroom with two closets, providing ample storage.    Additional highlights of this apartment include two designated parking spaces with guest passes, ensuring plenty of parking for residents and visitors alike.    The HOA covers a range of services, including grounds maintenance, trash removal, snow removal, hot water, sewer, property maintenance, and insurance, providing a hassle-free living experience.   Low taxes and reasonable HOA fees make this an affordable option in a prime location! Live comfortably at Woodside Green - come see this charming unit today! Bonus: No rental restrictions!
